# Academic writing 2: structuring an argument

## A Organising the text

Here are some useful collocations for organising one’s arguments.

Adverbs in English fall into two main categories: those ending in _–ly_ (e.g. softly) and those with other endings (e.g. well).

Later, I shall **make reference to** the work of Georgi Perelmuter, a **leading figure** in the field of zoology.

In this chapter, I **draw a distinction between** societies where democracy has developed slowly and those where it **came about** quickly or suddenly.

Chapter 3 **raises important questions** about the need for transport planning in the **rapidly growing** urban environments. It also touches on issues such as pollution.

But we also need to **take into consideration** the economic history of Latin America as a whole.

This chapter **makes a case for** re-examining the assassination of President Kennedy **in the light of** evidence which has emerged since 1963.

sessions.title: B Reinforcing arguments
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ để củng cố lập luận của bạn.
sessions.value:
# Academic writing 2: structuring an argument

## B Reinforcing arguments

Look at these extracts from university lectures and note the collocations.

Many studies have attempted to **assess the significance** of diet in the prevention of cancer.
Wastov **lays emphasis on** examining the vital first three years of a child’s development.
These statistics **lend support** to the view that attitudes to the environment are changing fundamentally.

sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ khác để đề cập đến lập luận.
sessions.value:
# Academic writing 2: structuring an argument

## C More collocations for referring to arguments

The book _The Eye of the Universe_ **draws an analogy**¹ between the birth of the universe and a lottery. It also **draws parallels**² between the formation of new stars and the birth and death of flowers. It **presents the case for** a complete rethinking of how we understand space. The author, Patrick Rivaux, **puts forward the argument** that the universe is as it is because we humans are here looking at it. The author **takes up / adopts the position** that the universe cannot have any beginning or end, and **states his opinion** that we can never understand the universe using the human ideas of time and space. He **argues convincingly**³ that the universe has a unique nature. He **draws attention to** new research which suggests that other universes may also exist alongside ours. He briefly **summarises**⁴ the views of leading physicists and mathematicians, **disagrees profoundly**⁵ with some of them and **draws the conclusion** that science alone cannot solve the mystery of the universe.

1 makes a comparison between things which have similar features, to help explain an idea
2 says that something is very similar to something else
3 argues in a way that makes people believe that something is true or right
4 expresses the most important idea in a short and clear form
5 disagrees very strongly or in an extreme way

sections.instruction_vi:
Cuốn sách _The Eye of the Universe_ đưa ra một phép loại¹ giữa sự ra đời của vũ trụ và một cuộc xổ số. Nó cũng đưa ra sự tương đồng² giữa sự hình thành các ngôi sao mới và sự ra đời và cái chết của hoa. Nó trình bày trường hợp cho một sự suy nghĩ lại hoàn toàn về cách chúng ta hiểu không gian. Tác giả, Patrick Rivaux, đưa ra lập luận rằng vũ trụ như nó vốn có là vì chúng ta, con người, ở đây để nhìn vào nó. Tác giả chấp nhận / áp dụng quan điểm rằng vũ trụ không thể có bất kỳ khởi đầu hoặc kết thúc nào, và nêu ý kiến của mình rằng chúng ta không bao giờ có thể hiểu vũ trụ bằng cách sử dụng các ý tưởng của con người về thời gian và không gian. Ông ấy lập luận một cách thuyết phục³ rằng vũ trụ có một bản chất độc đáo. Ông ấy thu hút sự chú ý đến nghiên cứu mới cho thấy rằng các vũ trụ khác cũng có thể tồn tại song song với vũ trụ của chúng ta. Ông ấy tóm tắt ngắn gọn⁴ các quan điểm của các nhà vật lý và toán học hàng đầu, hoàn toàn không đồng ý⁵ với một số người trong số họ và đi đến kết luận rằng khoa học một mình không thể giải quyết bí ẩn của vũ trụ.

1 makes a comparison between things which have similar features, to help explain an idea
2 says that something is very similar to something else
3 argues in a way that makes people believe that something is true or right
4 expresses the most important idea in a short and clear form
5 disagrees very strongly or in an extreme way

image.value: A top-down view of a person arranging printed paragraphs and sections of a document on a desk to create a logical flow.

senses.definition_vi: Cách thức sắp xếp và cấu trúc các ý tưởng trong văn bản một cách logic.
examples: Organising the text effectively helps the reader follow complex academic arguments.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để nói về kỹ năng viết luận hoặc soạn thảo văn bản.

image.value: Various colorful objects being sorted into separate glass jars, representing classification.

senses.definition_vi: Được chia thành hoặc thuộc về các nhóm, loại khác nhau.
examples: The collected data fall into three main categories based on age groups.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi phân loại sự vật, hiện tượng trong nghiên cứu hoặc trình bày.

use_prompts.question: What types of people use public libraries?
What different kinds of shoppers are there?
What kinds of TV programmes are popular in your country?

dictation.text: Most of our customers fall into three categories.

paraphrase.source: Students' problems can be divided into two main groups.
paraphrase.model: Students' problems fall into two main categories.

paraphrase.source: The complaints we received are of three main types.
paraphrase.model: The complaints we received fall into three categories.

image.value: An open academic book with a hand pointing to a specific citation or footnote.

senses.definition_vi: Đề cập đến, nhắc đến hoặc dẫn dẫn một nguồn tài liệu nào đó.
examples: In her speech, she made reference to the recent changes in environmental policy.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Trang trọng hơn từ 'mention'.

use_prompts.question: How should students use other writers' ideas in their essays?
Should politicians mention their personal lives in speeches?
Why do many films include ideas from older stories?

dictation.text: Try to make reference to the text in your answer.

paraphrase.source: In his speech, the president mentioned the recent floods.
paraphrase.model: In his speech, the president makes reference to the recent floods.

paraphrase.source: Good essays mention research to support their ideas.
paraphrase.model: Good essays make reference to research to support their ideas.

image.value: A person drawing a clear line on a white board between two different concepts or diagrams.

senses.definition_vi: Phân biệt hoặc vạch ra sự khác nhau rõ rệt giữa hai khái niệm.
examples: The report draws a distinction between short-term profits and long-term growth.
senses.grammar_patterns: draw a distinction between A and B
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong văn phong học thuật để làm rõ các khái niệm dễ nhầm lẫn.

use_prompts.question: What is the difference between being educated and being intelligent?
Is a job the same thing as a career?
How is online friendship different from friendship in real life?

dictation.text: We must draw a distinction between wants and needs.

paraphrase.source: It is important to separate news clearly from opinion.
paraphrase.model: It is important to draw a distinction between news and opinion.

paraphrase.source: The teacher explains how weather is different from climate.
paraphrase.model: The teacher draws a distinction between weather and climate.

image.value: A student in a university lecture hall raising their hand to ask a question.

senses.definition_vi: Gợi ra hoặc làm nảy sinh những câu hỏi, nghi vấn cần giải đáp.
examples: The sudden drop in sales raises questions about the company's future.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi một sự việc khiến người khác phải suy nghĩ hoặc nghi ngờ.

use_prompts.question: What are people's concerns about artificial intelligence replacing human workers?
Is it worrying that so many children are overweight?
What concerns do people have about building new airports?

dictation.text: The new plan raises questions about safety.

paraphrase.source: The accident makes people wonder whether the bridge is safe.
paraphrase.model: The accident raises questions about the safety of the bridge.

paraphrase.source: The rise in online shopping makes us ask what will happen to small shops.
paraphrase.model: The rise in online shopping raises questions about the future of small shops.

image.value: A close-up of a finger lightly touching a specific point on a world map representing a global topic.

senses.definition_vi: Đề cập ngắn gọn hoặc sơ qua đến các vấn đề.
examples: The documentary touches on issues of poverty and social inequality.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Ngụ ý rằng người nói không đi sâu vào chi tiết mà chỉ điểm qua.

use_prompts.question: What topics should documentaries cover?
Should school lessons discuss difficult subjects like poverty and racism?
Can popular songs teach us about social problems?

dictation.text: The film touches on issues of family and loss.

paraphrase.source: The novel briefly mentions problems such as poverty and racism.
paraphrase.model: The novel touches on issues such as poverty and racism.

paraphrase.source: The lecture briefly deals with questions of online privacy.
paraphrase.model: The lecture touches on issues of online privacy.

image.value: A professional person weighing options on their hands, looking thoughtful.

senses.definition_vi: Xem xét, cân nhắc kỹ lưỡng một yếu tố nào đó trước khi quyết định.
examples: We must take into consideration the local weather conditions before planning the trip.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Đồng nghĩa với 'take into account'.

use_prompts.question: What should young people think about when they choose a career?
What should people consider when they buy a home?
What do you think about before you book a holiday?

dictation.text: We should take into consideration the cost of living.

paraphrase.source: When choosing a university, students should think about the cost of living.
paraphrase.model: When choosing a university, students should take into consideration the cost of living.

paraphrase.source: Planners must consider the needs of older residents.
paraphrase.model: Planners must take into consideration the needs of older residents.

image.value: An advocate presenting evidence in front of a group to prove a point.

senses.definition_vi: Đưa ra các lý lẽ, lập luận để ủng hộ hoặc thuyết phục cho một điều gì đó.
examples: The author makes a strong case for adopting more sustainable farming practices.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong lập luận để thuyết phục người khác rằng điều gì đó là đúng hoặc cần thiết.

use_prompts.question: Should schools teach financial skills to children?
What reasons are there for investing more in public transport?
Why should governments put taxes on sugary drinks?

dictation.text: The article makes a case for longer school holidays.

paraphrase.source: The report argues that cities should have more bicycle lanes.
paraphrase.model: The report makes a case for more bicycle lanes in cities.

paraphrase.source: The doctor gives good reasons why people should walk every day.
paraphrase.model: The doctor makes a case for walking every day.

image.value: Adding steel bars to a concrete structure to make it stronger, acting as a metaphor for logic.

senses.definition_vi: Việc củng cố hoặc làm cho các lập luận trở nên thuyết phục và vững chắc hơn.
examples: Providing statistical data is essential for reinforcing arguments in a research paper.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để mô tả hành động làm tăng sức nặng cho quan điểm của mình.

image.value: An expert examining an ancient artifact through a magnifying glass to determine its value.

senses.definition_vi: Đánh giá mức độ quan trọng hoặc ý nghĩa của một sự việc.
examples: It is still too early to fully assess the significance of these archaeological finds.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng trong ngữ cảnh chuyên môn, học thuật khi cần nhận định tầm ảnh hưởng.

use_prompts.question: Is it too early to know how artificial intelligence will change society?
How can historians decide which events in the past were the most important?
How can we judge whether a new trade agreement will really matter?

dictation.text: It is too early to assess the significance of this discovery.

paraphrase.source: Experts are trying to judge how important the new discovery really is.
paraphrase.model: Experts are trying to assess the significance of the new discovery.

paraphrase.source: We cannot yet say how much the new law matters.
paraphrase.model: We cannot yet assess the significance of the new law.

image.value: A text with a specific word highlighted in bright yellow to draw attention.

senses.definition_vi: Nhấn mạnh hoặc tập trung sự chú ý vào một điều gì đó.
examples: The new curriculum lays great emphasis on practical skills rather than theory.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Đồng nghĩa với 'emphasise' nhưng mang tính trang trọng hơn.

use_prompts.question: What does the education system in your country focus on most?
What should public health campaigns focus on?
What qualities do employers value most in new staff?

dictation.text: Our school lays emphasis on practical skills.

paraphrase.source: The new course focuses strongly on speaking skills.
paraphrase.model: The new course lays emphasis on speaking skills.

paraphrase.source: The company considers teamwork very important.
paraphrase.model: The company lays great emphasis on teamwork.

image.value: Several pillars holding up a massive stone ceiling, representing structural support.

senses.definition_vi: Cung cấp thêm bằng chứng hoặc lý lẽ để chứng minh một điều gì đó là đúng.
examples: Recent scientific studies lend support to the theory of global warming.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng khi một dữ liệu mới củng cố cho một giả thuyết có sẵn.

use_prompts.question: Does recent research show that exercise improves mental health?
Do recent extreme weather events prove that climate change is real?
Should famous people publicly back charities and social campaigns?

dictation.text: These results lend support to the new theory.

paraphrase.source: New studies help to confirm the idea that sleep improves memory.
paraphrase.model: New studies lend support to the idea that sleep improves memory.

paraphrase.source: Several celebrities have backed the campaign against plastic waste.
paraphrase.model: Several celebrities have lent support to the campaign against plastic waste.

image.value: A person with a determined expression, hands clenched, representing strong conviction.

senses.definition_vi: Giữ vững hoặc kiên định với một niềm tin, quan điểm.
examples: Despite much criticism, the professor held firmly to his belief in the project's success.
senses.grammar_patterns: hold firmly to the belief that [clause]
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ sự kiên định không thay đổi ý kiến dù gặp áp lực.

use_prompts.question: Why do some people refuse to change their opinions even when they are given new facts?
Do you think hard work is more important than talent?
Do older people in your country keep traditional ideas about family?

dictation.text: My parents hold firmly to the belief that education matters.

paraphrase.source: Many older people are completely sure that hard work always brings success.
paraphrase.model: Many older people hold firmly to the belief that hard work always brings success.

paraphrase.source: The scientist still strongly believes that his theory is correct.
paraphrase.model: The scientist holds firmly to the belief that his theory is correct.

item_14.word: More collocations for referring to arguments

image.value: A mind map with many branches showing different academic terms related to debate and logic.

senses.definition_vi: Các cụm từ khác dùng để đề cập hoặc thảo luận về các lập luận.
examples: The teacher provided a list of more collocations for referring to arguments to improve our writing.
senses.grammar_patterns: more collocations for referring to arguments
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cụm từ này thường dùng làm tiêu đề trong sách học tiếng Anh.

image.value: A diagram comparing an apple and a globe to explain gravity, showing a metaphorical link.

senses.definition_vi: Đưa ra một sự so sánh tương đồng để giải thích một khái niệm khó hiểu.
examples: The speaker draws an analogy between a human brain and a supercomputer.
senses.grammar_patterns: draw an analogy between A and B
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi so sánh hai thứ có vẻ khác nhau nhưng có điểm chung để minh họa ý tưởng.

use_prompts.question: How can teachers explain difficult ideas to young students?
Is the human brain similar to a computer?
Why do journalists often compare current events to past ones?

dictation.text: The teacher draws an analogy between the heart and a pump.

paraphrase.source: The writer compares the internet to a huge library.
paraphrase.model: The writer draws an analogy between the internet and a huge library.

paraphrase.source: The speaker compares running a business to sailing a ship.
paraphrase.model: The speaker draws an analogy between running a business and sailing a ship.

image.value: Two parallel railway tracks stretching into the distance, representing similar paths.

senses.definition_vi: Chỉ ra những điểm tương đồng, giống nhau giữa hai sự việc/tình huống.
examples: Historians often draw parallels between the current economic crisis and the Great Depression.
senses.grammar_patterns: draw parallels between A and B
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong phân tích lịch sử hoặc xã hội.

use_prompts.question: Is the current economic situation similar to crises in the past?
Are there similarities between your culture and other Asian cultures?
Can we learn anything from comparing modern problems with those in history?

dictation.text: The film draws parallels between the past and the present.

paraphrase.source: The book compares life today with life a hundred years ago.
paraphrase.model: The book draws parallels between life today and life a hundred years ago.

paraphrase.source: Historians often point out similarities between the two wars.
paraphrase.model: Historians often draw parallels between the two wars.

image.value: A lawyer standing in court, holding a folder and addressing the jury.

senses.definition_vi: Trình bày các lý do ủng hộ một quan điểm hoặc hành động.
examples: The latest report presents the case for a complete overhaul of the education system.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Tương tự 'make a case for', nhưng nhấn mạnh vào hành động trình bày chính thức.

use_prompts.question: Should university education be free for everyone?
Why should cities ban cars from their centres?
Should governments make daily exercise compulsory in schools?

dictation.text: The report presents the case for free school meals.

paraphrase.source: The article explains the reasons in favour of a four-day working week.
paraphrase.model: The article presents the case for a four-day working week.

paraphrase.source: The minister gives reasons why taxes on petrol should rise.
paraphrase.model: The minister presents the case for higher taxes on petrol.

image.value: A person pushing a document across a table toward others during a serious discussion.

senses.definition_vi: Đề xuất hoặc đưa ra một lập luận để thảo luận.
examples: In his book, Smith puts forward the argument that technology is isolating us.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Sử dụng khi giới thiệu một ý tưởng hoặc quan điểm mới vào cuộc tranh luận.

use_prompts.question: Do you agree that technology makes people lonelier?
Is it better for children to start school later?
Should companies allow employees to work from home?

dictation.text: The writer puts forward the argument that homework is useless.

paraphrase.source: In his essay, the writer suggests that social media isolates people.
paraphrase.model: In his essay, the writer puts forward the argument that social media isolates people.

paraphrase.source: The scientist claims that cities should plant more trees.
paraphrase.model: The scientist puts forward the argument that cities should plant more trees.

image.value: A chess player firmly placing a piece on the board, choosing a strategic stance.

senses.definition_vi: Chấp nhận hoặc bắt đầu theo đuổi một lập trường/quan điểm cụ thể.
examples: The government has adopted the position that taxes must not be raised further.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ việc một cá nhân hay tổ chức công khai chọn một phe trong cuộc tranh luận.

use_prompts.question: What should governments do about rising house prices?
Should countries stop using coal immediately?
Should schools ban mobile phones completely?

dictation.text: The government adopts the position that taxes must stay low.

paraphrase.source: The school has officially decided that phones are not allowed in class.
paraphrase.model: The school adopts the position that phones are not allowed in class.

paraphrase.source: The newspaper now officially argues that the airport should not be built.
paraphrase.model: The newspaper takes up the position that the airport should not be built.

image.value: A person speaking into a microphone at a press conference, expressing their views.

senses.definition_vi: Nêu rõ ý kiến hoặc quan điểm của mình một cách công khai.
examples: The manager states his opinion clearly at the beginning of every meeting.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Mang tính trang trọng hơn là dùng 'say'.

use_prompts.question: Should employees speak openly to their boss when they disagree?
Should TV news presenters tell viewers what they personally think?
Do children in your country express their views freely to their parents?

dictation.text: My father always states his opinion clearly.

paraphrase.source: The manager says clearly what he thinks at every meeting.
paraphrase.model: The manager states his opinion clearly at every meeting.

paraphrase.source: In the first paragraph, the writer tells us what he believes.
paraphrase.model: In the first paragraph, the writer states his opinion.

image.value: A debater gesturing with confidence, making the audience nod in agreement.

senses.definition_vi: Lập luận một cách đầy thuyết phục.
examples: She argues convincingly that the current law needs to be reformed immediately.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để khen ngợi khả năng thuyết phục của một bài viết hoặc bài nói.

use_prompts.question: What skills does a student need to win a debate?
What makes a politician persuasive?
What helps a candidate do well in a job interview?

dictation.text: She argues convincingly that cities need more parks.

paraphrase.source: The author gives strong, persuasive reasons why the law should change.
paraphrase.model: The author argues convincingly that the law should change.

paraphrase.source: The lawyer uses strong reasons to persuade the court that her client is innocent.
paraphrase.model: The lawyer argues convincingly that her client is innocent.

image.value: A red arrow pointing to a specific detail on a document, highlighting it.

senses.definition_vi: Làm cho mọi người chú ý hoặc tập trung vào một điều gì đó.
examples: The author draws attention to the often overlooked role of women in the war.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để nhấn mạnh một khía cạnh quan trọng mà người khác có thể bỏ lỡ.

senses.definition_vi: Nghiên cứu mới chỉ ra hoặc cho thấy điều gì đó (thường mang tính thăm dò).
examples: New research suggests that drinking green tea may lower the risk of heart disease.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng từ 'suggests' thay vì 'proves' để thể hiện sự thận trọng trong khoa học.

senses.definition_vi: Tóm tắt ngắn gọn các ý chính.

senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi chỉ muốn nêu lại những điểm cốt yếu nhất một cách nhanh chóng.

senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng khi sự khác biệt về quan điểm là rất lớn, không thể dung hòa.
